text:
ana_csm: Heads-up — FlightSchool requested a QBR readout next Tues about onboarding costs. They flagged a 2.4x spike in embed generation after last week's index run.

sam_cs: Oof. Do we have the raw daily burn? want a quick forecast to show them and propose mitigations. :grimacing:

mark_platform: I pulled the logs earlier — spikes line up with bulk re-index + high-precision embedding model (text-embedding-bert-large). They didn't switch to cache-friendly mode.

lina_finops: Can you paste a one-slide forecast? CFO asked for runway impact if this continues for 30 days.

mark_platform: Quick numbers (from prod telemetry):
```
current avg daily tokens: 12M tokens/day
current avg daily embedding units: 1.8M units/day
cost today (est): $2,200/day
spike peak day: 5.4M embeddings (~$6,600/day)
30-day linear projection if peak persists: ~$156k
```

ana_csm: @ana_csm (typo) — noted. We should present three scenarios in the QBR: mitigated, partially mitigated, uncontrolled.

ana_csm: Mitigated = throttle + batching + switch to quantized embed model. Partially = throttle only. Uncontrolled = status quo.

sam_cs: Proposed mitigations I can own in the enablement plan: 1) apply short-term quota (10% headroom) 2) enable server-side batching + TTL cache 3) swap to embed-lite model for index rebuilds. I can push a config change and a runbook.

lina_finops: Add expected savings:
```
Mitigated (throttle + batch + embed-lite): ~72% cost reduction vs peak
Partially mitigated (throttle only): ~35% reduction
No mitigation: 0%
```

ana_csm: Can we get timing? FlightSchool is mid-onboard; any config change must be low-risk and reversible.

mark_platform: I can ship a reversible config toggle for batching + embed-lite today, low-risk. Throttle/quota requires coordination with product but can be set via console; I'll draft the values.

sam_cs: I'll coordinate comms and ask FlightSchool to approve a one-hour maintenance window for the index rebuild to re-run with embed-lite.

ops-bot: Reminder set: QBR deck draft due in 48h — @ana_csm, @sam_cs, @lina_finops, @mark_platform.

lina_finops: For the deck, please include a short cost-sensitivity table and a suggested guardrail: auto-throttle at 400% of baseline and a hard quota alert at 800%.

ana_csm: Noted. I'll template the slide and include the action items and runbook link. Suggest the slide shows current spend, peak, and mitigated projection with % savings.

sam_cs: Action items:
- sam_cs: request maintenance window & get FlightSchool approval (ETA 6h)
- mark_platform: push reversible batch/embed-lite toggle + config values (ETA 4h)
- lina_finops: create cost-sensitivity table and quick notes for CFO (ETA 8h)
- ana_csm: draft QBR slide and runbook link (ETA 12h)

ana_csm: Anyone object to the guardrail numbers?

lina_finops: Numbers look reasonable given current baseline. We'll monitor for regressions in accuracy post-switch and include QA checks in the runbook.

mark_platform: I'll add a short A/B eval checklist for top 100 queries to validate embed-lite before full rollout.

sam_cs: Great. Once FlightSchool okays the window, I'll post customer-facing note and add the mitigated projection to the QBR.

ana_csm: Thanks team — let's reconvene async here once each ETA completes. I'll mark the thread for the deck. :white_check_mark:
